Graphics preparation 0.20.0 connects the staged material Height pipeline to real refined geometry.

- Adds **Height micro-displacement** to the 3D Geometry Enhancement panel and to the one-click Modern / PS5 target.
- Adds **Height source** selection: Auto, Sidecar only, or conservative Diffuse-derived fallback.
- Adds bounded displacement strength controls; 80% is the Modern preset default.
- Prefers the existing `Materials/<hash>/height.png` and `material.json` generated by the texture/material pipeline.
- Reads the authored neutral height and parallax-scale hint, then clamps them again through stricter material-specific physical limits.
- Can auto-detect one compatible material-pack ZIP/directory beside the Geometry Job, or accept `--material-pack <path>` explicitly.
- Uses OpenRAC's own PNG reader for sidecars and exported Diffuse textures; no new image dependency is required.
- Diffuse fallback reconstructs a conservative relative coarse/mid/micro Height field and is capped to 45% of authored-sidecar displacement.
- Displacement samples through `TEXCOORD_0` with repeat-safe UV wrapping and moves vertices along reconstructed normals.
- Open boundaries and preserved hard creases are pinned before displacement.
- Transparent Height pixels do not move geometry.
- Terrain and mobys remain position-locked unless **Allow visual/collision mismatch** is explicitly enabled.
- Collision QA now includes micro-displacement movement as well as shape refinement.
- `geometry-report.json` reports displacement primitives, sidecar-vs-Diffuse source counts, maximum movement and material-pack provenance.
- Existing adaptive subdivision, crease preservation, angle-weighted normals/tangents, skin/UV interpolation and OpenRAC `assets.py` round trip remain intact.
- Texture AI cache identity is unchanged; adding geometry displacement does not rerun completed neural texture work.
